title: Establish the V4-P9 Lightweight Web UI decisions and roadmap
goal: Accept a non-authoritative local Web UI boundary, define phased V4-P9 implementation checkpoints and preserve all first-release exclusions before any UI code is implemented.
acceptanceCriteria: V4-AD-017 defines the Web UI as an observation and allowlisted command surface over the V4 host, never a policy or verdict engine.
The maintained runtime architecture shows the local Web Companion and preserves PackageRoot, TargetRoot, StateRoot and EvidenceRoot ownership.
The parent roadmap contains separately authorized V4-P9 planning and implementation checkpoints.
V4-TODO-005 remains open and records every excluded first-release capability requested by the user.
The planning index accurately distinguishes released V4 1.0.0 from the unimplemented V4-P9 roadmap.
No executable, dependency, package, profile, module, workflow, ruleset or remote state changes occur.
